title: Frequently Asked Questions — Western States 100 (finish cut-offs)
claims: At the finish, 24-hour runners must arrive by 5:00 a.m. Sunday and 30-hour runners by 11:00 a.m.
Many checkpoints are restricted to race officials because of limited parking and the need to keep narrow access roads clear for fire and rescue equipment.
Spectators are asked to stay within 1/4 mile of the checkpoints and not to provide food, beverages or other assistance outside the main checkpoint areas.
